record: N8-31 frozen-cell addendum: review-adopted obligations transcribed BEFORE any N8-31 results exist
pre_results_declaration: At this timestamp optimization_v8_native_default/evidence/trials/ contained no files (this record creates the directory). No A/B/C comparison result, timed or untimed, has been produced under N8-31. This addendum is therefore a pre-results protocol amendment, not a post-hoc gate edit. Base freeze instruments remain authoritative: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md (dossier), native/quiet_window_abc.py (B=128+1024, mixes, A/B/C arms, parity before timing, min-of-N, INFORMATIONAL/NON-PROMOTION), and the n8-13 harness.

binding_cells.obligation: N6 position (reviewer, adopted): NO dispatch-level scene-size guard in src; the size envelope is a RECORD obligation.
binding_cells.requirement: The first qualified record (N8-31 transcription or N8-32 selection) MUST state the scene-size envelope explicitly: approximately 2.25 GB routed-call overhead at 1024^2 and approximately 9 GB at 2048^2, P=153 (whole-scene uint32 AoSoA x3 + bool sun/shade x2, per n8_40_integration_record memory note). N8-31 end-to-end cells MUST include whole-process-peak accounting covering the whole-scene producer allocations (produce_blocks_aosoa + classify_block_aosoa outputs plus the legacy-loop inputs they duplicate).
binding_cells.rationale: N8-32 cannot qualify a scope it has not stated; BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL memory-pressure kills are censored runs and must be attributable to a stated envelope.

binding_cells.obligation: N7 (reviewer): per-call registry read on every routed-eligible driver call.
binding_cells.requirement: N8-31 end-to-end accounting MUST include one resolve_lw_backend() call (one small JSON stat+read) per driver call in the routed arm's cost. The fair shipped-state baseline arm (row A in repo state) pays the identical read, so both arms carry it; the cell must record that the read disappears only at N8-41 vendoring if a caching variant is ever proposed.
binding_cells.rationale: Omitting it would overstate routed-arm cost relative to a post-vendoring deployment; including it keeps the repo-state comparison faithful to both arms.

A (current Numba) / B (equivalent-layout Numba) / C (native) all three arms remain required with parity before timing
